meta.title: Session link
meta.description: Discover ordinary sessions across this profile's workspaces and exchange tasks and replies through native DSH inboxes. Tools: sessions_list, session_send and session_result. Recipients retain their model, cwd, tools and approval policy. Requires a full-access ordinary caller; excludes archived sessions and subagents. No automatic forwarding; relay depth is bounded. Installed independently of DSH core.
